score_reasoning.trust: Exceptional trust signals: 4.79-star rating, 1,679 reviews, and 5,000+ bought provide strong social proof. Mentions nationally certified reflexologists (ARCB), includes positive review quotes, and displays multiple massage-type badges. This is well above average.

score_reasoning.seo: Meta title is good (58 chars, includes brand/price/location), H1 is keyword-rich, and schema markup is present. However, meta description is underutilized at only 103 characters (should be closer to 155), and both OG title and OG description are missing, limiting social sharing performance.

A cautious buyer would have unanswered planning questions.
